description: Local document parsing to text/markdown (PDF, Office, images, CSV); scanned docs parsed on-GPU via an Ollama vision model.
fullDescription:
## OVERVIEW ##
Docling parses documents into clean, structured text/markdown, running entirely locally — no cloud service and no data leaving the machine.

Supported inputs include:
- PDF (text or scanned)
- Microsoft Office: DOCX, XLSX, PPTX
- Images (PNG, JPEG, TIFF)
- HTML, Markdown, AsciiDoc, CSV

Text PDFs and Office/CSV parse on the CPU image (no GPU claimed). Scanned PDFs and images are transcribed by an Ollama vision model, reached through the ComfyUI Studio LLM API — so that work runs on the GPU via Studio's single-GPU queue, with no custom GPU image.

## ADD THE API KEY (scanned-doc path) ##
No key is stored in the app package. The scanned-doc path reads a Studio API key at runtime from a Kubernetes Secret (default name 'docling-vlm', key 'STUDIO_API_KEY'). The CPU path works without it.

1. In ComfyUI Studio -> Settings -> API keys, create a key with the 'chat:write' scope.
2. kubectl -n <namespace> create secret generic docling-vlm --from-literal=STUDIO_API_KEY='sk_...'
3. kubectl -n <namespace> rollout restart deploy/docling
